create_env_instance: create an environment instance by calling create_env with a full environment name like atari_breakout
create_env_with_config: create an environment instance with system configuration and worker index via env_config parameter
create_env_atari: create an Atari environment by passing atari_breakout as the full_env_name to create_env
create_env_doom: create a Doom environment by passing doom_battle as the full_env_name to create_env
review_create_env: review the create_env factory function that resolves environment names and delegates to registered make_env_func
